workLog.outcome: _split_document drops YAML frontmatter by design. _added_sections therefore returns an empty dict for a frontmatter-only diff. _missing_siblings_already_current tested 'if not changed', which collapsed that empty dict together with None (a genuine parse failure) into one fail-closed verdict.

workLog.action: Proved the empty dict is a positive result, not an absence of information. Reaching the return past every guard in _added_sections establishes equal preambles, equal heading sets, and no differing body, so an empty result means the modelled document is byte-identical to base.
workLog.outcome: Replaced 'if not changed' with 'if changed is None' and added an explicit early return True for the empty case, placed after the loop that demands the same delta from every touched member and before the missing-sibling scan.

workLog.action: Rejected the tree-specific carve-out the PRD proposed. No path prefix is consulted anywhere in the fix.

patterns.pattern: Read the parser before accepting a proposed carve-out
patterns.context: The generated PRD proposed a carve-out keyed on the src/copilot-cli/agents/ and src/vs-code-agents/ path prefixes.
patterns.application: Reading _split_document and _added_sections showed the property is a fact about the diff's content, not the tree, so a narrower fix covered the template and hand-maintained copies too.

patterns.pattern: Relax a gate only when another gate owns what you stopped checking
patterns.context: Passing a frontmatter-only generated-tree diff could hide a stale generated file.
patterns.application: build/generate_agents.py --validate compares whole files including frontmatter and runs in CI and the pre-commit hook, so nothing is lost. Cited both call sites in the code.

patterns.pattern: Mutation-test the placement of an early return
patterns.context: The new return True could have gone after the missing-sibling scan instead of before it.
patterns.application: Deleting the block failed exactly one test, proving the placement is pinned rather than incidental.

avoidances.antipattern: 'if not x' over an Optional collection
avoidances.consequence: An empty result and a None result look alike under a truthiness test while meaning opposite things. Here it collapsed 'provably nothing changed' into 'cannot vouch' and blocked 30 agents.
avoidances.correction: Test 'x is None' for the failure case and handle the empty case on its own terms.

avoidances.antipattern: Repeating a claim from an issue body without opening the file
avoidances.consequence: The issue's model-value table described a different branch state; asserting it verbatim would have shipped an unverified claim in a docstring.
avoidances.correction: Read all six committed copies before quoting them. Three distinct model values were confirmed at level 1 and quoted verbatim.
